### Independent Six-Axis Review — PR #43 (`67050d629d45efa4677ca72eba0a362b1f698d35`)

- **Repository:** `chaproi/club-expense-approval`
- **PR / Branch:** `#43` (`fix/issue-42-f05-draft-recovery` → `staging/sprint-2`)
- **Reviewed Base / HEAD SHA:** `ed06b112e8a61890b10daaf76ddbd9632f77c88c` → `67050d629d45efa4677ca72eba0a362b1f698d35`
- **Reviewer Account:** `thananun-7203` (independent from Author `chaproi`)
- **Review Date:** `2026-11-25` (`Asia/Bangkok`)
- **Decision:** **REQUEST_CHANGES** *(1 concrete UI state-machine defect found in `client/src/expense-requests.tsx`; address inside this same PR and request re-review on the updated HEAD)*

| Axis | Verdict | Verified Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1. Identity, provenance & governance** | **PASS** | Independent reviewer `thananun-7203` != author `chaproi`. Links `Refs #42 and #36`, declares AI assistance, follows contract (`cda5069`) → RED (`1667ec2` / `0a006d3`) → GREEN (`ffefb2d` / `529a489`) → status (`67050d6`). Verified `git diff 1667ec2..67050d6 -- client/test/f05-draft-recovery.spec.ts` is empty (RED suite unchanged in GREEN) and `git diff ffefb2d..67050d6` contains only docs/evidence. `git diff --check` is clean across all 13 files. |
| **2. Scope, requirements & traceability** | **PASS** | Production code change is strictly bounded to `client/src/expense-requests.tsx` (`+218 / -44`); zero API, Prisma schema, migration, or lockfile edits. Adds `F-05 v1.1` contract (`AC-F05-07`–`AC-F05-11`), 14 Playwright browser cases (`client/test/f05-draft-recovery.spec.ts`), and action-specific Save/Resubmit error wording. Dependency audit and populated Sprint 1 DB upgrade remain explicitly tracked as separate release gates. |
| **3. Implementation, security & correctness** | **FAIL** *(1 binding finding below)* | Security and core conflict paths are strong: `401` clears all account drafts, `403`/`404` clears only the denied request's draft, drafts live strictly in tab memory (cleared on unmount/logout/account switch/reload, zero browser storage), no automatic writes on refresh/Restore/Discard/Retry, and `400`/transport errors preserve editable input with action-specific messages. However, **BF-01** below leaves a phantom draft in `drafts` when restored/edited values match the latest saved values, which breaks the `F-05 v1.1` rule (*"The resulting form is unsaved if it differs from the latest values"*) and causes a subsequent successful `Resubmit request` to re-enter the read-only conflict recovery UI on a newly `SUBMITTED` request. |
| **4. Build, testing & evidence** | **PASS** *(add regression for BF-01)* | Hosted CI [`45553875619`](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/actions/runs/45553875619/job/139001178059) passed `SUCCESS` on exact HEAD `67050d6`: `npm test` **47/47 PASS** (`0 fail`, `0 skipped`), `npm run build` **PASS**, Playwright E2E **17/17 PASS** (`19.9s` — 14 new + 3 inherited), Docker build **PASS**. Independently checked out `67050d6` locally (Node `v24.14.0`): `npm run build` **PASS** (`1.85s`), pure unit/canonical-origin suites **11/11 PASS** *(DB-backed API and Playwright E2E covered by hosted PG 17 / Chromium CI)*. |
| **5. Documentation & status consistency** | **PASS** *(see minor note)* | `docs/contracts/f-05-edit-resubmit.md`, `docs/features.md`, `docs/traceability.md`, `docs/reviewer-handoff.md`, and `docs/evidence/deliverable-2/f05-draft-recovery-*.md` truthfully separate local/source verification from pending peer review, integration, release, and deployment gates. |
| **6. Closure, prior findings & completeness** | **FAIL** | Blocked by **BF-01** below; address in this same PR (no new PR) and keep `#42` / `#36` open until reviewed integration and release gates complete. |

---

### Binding Finding

#### BF-01 — Clean restored draft is not cleared, causing false reload warning and stale recovery UI after successful Resubmit
- **Location:** `client/src/expense-requests.tsx` lines `139–160` (`restoreDraft`, `changeEdit`) and lines `191–197` (`mutate` success branch).
- **Contract reference:** `docs/contracts/f-05-edit-resubmit.md` (v1.1), items 2 & 3:
  - *"A field where the latest value agrees with the draft needs no conflict marker."*
  - *"Restore stages only the captured changed fields on top of the latest saved values. Unchanged fields keep the latest values. The resulting form is unsaved if it differs from the latest values."*
- **Observed behavior & reproduction:**
  1. **Scenario A (identical concurrent edit):** Two sessions for the same Requester open a `RETURNED` request (rev 1, `title: "Training expense"`, `category: "ACTIVITY"`, `amountBaht: 500`). Session A edits only `title` to `"Updated title"`. Session B saves `title: "Updated title"`, `category: "TRAVEL"`, `amountBaht: 500` (rev 2).
  2. Session A clicks **Save changes** → `409 INVALID_STATE` → refreshes rev 2 and shows the draft (`changedFields: ["title"]`).
  3. Session A clicks **Restore draft**. `next` becomes `{ title: "Updated title", category: "TRAVEL", amountBaht: "500" }`, which equals `current`.
  4. `restoreDraft()` unconditionally executes `updateDraft(captureDraft(detail, next, true))` (storing a draft with `changedFields: []`, `restored: true`, `base.revision: 2`).
     - Immediately, `dirty` is `false` so **Save changes** is disabled and **Resubmit request** is enabled — yet `drafts.size > 0` still renders `"Reloading this page will discard your unsaved draft."` and **Discard draft** even though there are zero unsaved differences.
  5. Session A clicks the enabled **Resubmit request** button → `POST /:id/resubmit` succeeds (`200 OK`, `status: "SUBMITTED"`, `revision: 3`).
  6. In `mutate()` (lines `193–196`), `updateDraft()` is only called when `action === "save"`, **not** when `action === "resubmit"`. The empty draft remains in `drafts`, flipping `recovering` to `true` (`!!draft && detail.status !== "RETURNED"`).
  7. Right after a clean, successful Resubmit, the UI unexpectedly renders **Latest saved values**, **Unsaved draft**, `"This request is read-only."`, **Discard draft**, and `"Reloading this page will discard your unsaved draft."`.
  - *(The same failure also occurs in **Scenario B**: after restoring a dirty draft, the owner edits the field back to match the latest saved value via `changeEdit()`, enabling **Resubmit request**, and clicks **Resubmit request**.)*
- **Required same-PR remedy:**
  1. In `restoreDraft()` (line `146`) and `changeEdit()` (line `159`), inspect `staged.changedFields.length`: when `0`, clear the draft (`updateDraft()` and in `restoreDraft()` reset `setEditValues(null)`) instead of retaining an empty draft.
  2. In `mutate()` success handling (lines `193–196`), also call `updateDraft()` on `action === "resubmit"` so a successful Resubmit can never leave a stale draft attached to a newly `SUBMITTED` request.
  3. Add a focused Playwright regression case in `client/test/f05-draft-recovery.spec.ts` covering a same-value Restore (or restored-then-reverted edit) followed by **Resubmit request**, verifying no false reload warning/draft panel appears and the `SUBMITTED` transition succeeds cleanly, then rerun full CI.

---

### Non-blocking Note
- When pushing the fix commit, consider also referencing the latest passing hosted PR `#43` CI run in `docs/traceability.md` / `docs/reviewer-handoff.md` alongside the local verification evidence.

Three clean same-PR follow-up commits address `BF-01` in TDD order: `95d7d2b` (RED tests) → `cb05d62` (minimal UI fix) → `f487956` (BF-01 evidence/docs). All prior security/privacy/concurrency invariants (`401`/`403`/`404` clearing, tab-memory-only scoping, no auto-writes, action-specific errors) remain intact. |
| **4. Build, testing & evidence** | **PASS** | Hosted CI [`45601140709`](https://github.com/chaproi/club-expense-approval/actions/runs/45601140709/job/139160055409) passed `SUCCESS` on exact HEAD `f487956511a79951656a2392bec002cde555ec67`: `npm run db:migrate` **PASS**, `npm test` **47/47 PASS** (`0 fail`, `0 skipped`), `npm run build` **PASS**, Playwright E2E **19/19 PASS** (`22.3s` — 16 F-05 draft-recovery cases including both `BF-01` regressions + 3 inherited cases), Docker build (`club-expense-approval:ci`) **PASS**. `docs/evidence/deliverable-2/f05-draft-recovery-bf01.md` and `.json` document the 2/2 behavioral RED failures on `95d7d2b` and 19/19 GREEN confirmation on `cb05d62`. Independently checked out `f487956` locally (Node `v24.14.0`): `npm run build` **PASS** (`1.87s`), pure unit/canonical-origin suites **11/11 PASS** *(DB-backed API and Playwright E2E covered by hosted PG 17 / Chromium CI run `45601140709`)*. |
| **5. Documentation & status consistency** | **PASS** | `f05-draft-recovery-bf01.md`, `docs/traceability.md`, and `docs/reviewer-handoff.md` preserve prior records (`67050d6` / run `45553875619`) without rewriting history and clearly separate source verification from pending staging integration, release gates, and deployment acceptance. |
| **6. Closure, prior findings & completeness** | **PASS** | Prior binding finding **`BF-01`** is completely resolved and regression-tested inside this same PR (`MERGEABLE`, `CLEAN`), with zero remaining binding findings and no premature closure of `#42` or `#36`. |
